g.text: Factory Scenario Description - Multi-Machine Predictive Maintenance
Defines the project's factory use case in a visual form.
A small factory floor monitors multiple machine types using
one ESP32 sensor node per machine, then sends machine health
telemetry to a gateway/cloud for alerts and maintenance decisions.
Physical measurements attached to each machine
Local edge device placed near one machine
Machine data sent upstream using Wi-Fi
Message path from gateway/cloud back to the selected ESP32
Human user who reviews alerts and plans maintenance
